title: Request Handling Performance
description: Nginx request and upstream latency, errors, sizes and top URLs (adapted from the application request-handling dashboard).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_upstream_time_seconds_hist_bucket{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (request_uri) topk(10, sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status=~"4..|5..",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (request_uri) topk(10, sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_upstream_time_seconds_hist_sum{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) and on (request_uri) topk(10, sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (request_uri, status) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status=~"4..|5..",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) and on (request_uri) topk(10, sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_size_bytes{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (request_uri) topk(10, sum by (request_uri) (rate(nginx_http_response_count_total{job="nginx",environment="$environment",instance=~"$instance",status!="404",request_uri!~"/ws|/api/_(health|version)"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)
